card.title: My Past Self Is Watching
card.instruction: Behave as though an earlier version of yourself is judging every choice. Alternate between honoring that identity and deliberately betraying it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I promised my younger self I'd never leave this town.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You also wanted to live on the moon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Some ambitions were symbolic. Loyalty wasn't.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. I'm taking the photograph so he can disapprove from a better view.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave that box. The boy in this photograph swore he'd never leave town or miss a home match.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The theatre job doubles your pay. I've booked the van.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Pack it. He can call me a traitor while I pay off our mortgage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll cancel your season ticket, then.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep it. I'll drive back every Saturday and let him judge me from our usual seat.

mechanism: A imagines a younger self judging a move, breaks the staying promise and preserves the football ritual.
confusable: Unlike simply moving on from youth, A must visibly alternate betrayal and allegiance in actual decisions.
comparison: S230-b keeps a recurring journey to the old seat; S230-a preserves a youthful color within a practical car.

bindingFindings.assessment: Not safely rebindable unchanged as a complete expression of the exact instruction. The childhood-photograph action, imagined-opinions opening and pride-seeking response establish a judging past self, while the adulthood challenge and covered-photograph closing suggest evasion or betrayal. Asking which choice would make that self proud does not establish actually honoring it, so these unchanged fragments do not clearly enact the required alternation. Both final singles now enact concrete allegiance, deliberate betrayal and renewed allegiance, but their clarity cannot supply a missing choice inside the transfer. Card ID, fingerprint, seed IDs, {prop}, {request} and {counter} slots, and compiled-pair-draft status remain untouched. Both supplied hashes retain original-source provenance rather than identifying revisions. No bespoke pairs or supporting seeds were supplied. This finding does not edit or newly score a pair; the separately documented S06+D49-b seed-description mismatch remains pending outside this scope.
